description:
Heo Myeong-Tae, a middle-aged man in his 40s, is constantly scolded by his wife for his early arrival (!). He habitually laments his situation at his local pub, only to end up drunk. Unintentionally, news of Myeong-Tae's plight has spread throughout the neighborhood, and everyone knows about it. The pub owner, feeling sorry for Myeong-Tae's exhaustion, orders his next-door neighbor and pub worker, Go Woo-Ju, to leave work early, citing his responsibility for Myeong-Tae's return. At home, where he has lived for years, he hears his wife's complaints, and at his part-time job, he hears Myeong-Tae's lamentations. It's all exhausting for Woo-Ju, who has simply offered to help Myeong-Tae with his sex life... But this middle-aged man is anything but ordinary!

A crazy romance between a humble and insignificant 40-year-old who has just embarked on a sacred journey and a young man in his 20s who meets someone he likes!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
